infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SnapMacros uses the camera so you can photograph your meals to log them.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SnapMacros needs photo access so you can attach meal photos from your library.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow SnapMacros to use the camera to photograph your meals.
plugins.photosPermission: Allow SnapMacros to access your photos to attach meal images.
